title: LS-MDRM Evaluation Manual
description: Defines evaluation separation, blind evaluator packet structure, adjudication rules, and disposition codes.

role_separation.description: Where possible, the following roles must be separated. Artifacts must permit another fresh context to perform each without hidden reasoning.

roles.generator: Produces the trajectory, branch candidates, and state scores.
roles.registrar: Records raw artifacts, hashes, and evidence bindings without modification.
roles.evaluator: Applies the rubric to produced artifacts, blind to generator's self-evaluation and desired result.
roles.adjudicator: Reviews evaluator outputs, issues dispositions, and flags protocol violations.

role_separation.minimum_requirement: Even in a single-operator context, artifacts must be structured so that each role's function can be replicated by an independent reader using only the frozen package.

blind_evaluator_packet_structure.description: A blind evaluator packet contains only what is needed to apply the rubric. It must not contain the items in omit_list.
must_contain: trajectory_record with state scores and branch records
fixture_type and fixture_id (but not the expected result)

evaluation_dimensions.schema_validity: Does the trajectory record conform to the machine-readable schemas?
evaluation_dimensions.branch_lifecycle_closure: Is B_n^selected in B_n^eligible for every transition?
evaluation_dimensions.raw_branch_preservation: Is B_n^raw fully preserved for every transition?
evaluation_dimensions.rejection_code_completeness: Does every excluded raw candidate have at least one rejection code?
evaluation_dimensions.claim_status_completeness: Does every material claim have an assigned status?
evaluation_dimensions.EPR_value: What is the EPR? Are all promotions licensed?
evaluation_dimensions.evidence_binding_completeness: Does every evidence binding include artifact_id, repository_commit, exact_location?
evaluation_dimensions.entropy_completeness: Are all four H components recorded and non-collapsed?
evaluation_dimensions.uncertainty_completeness: Is at least one uncertainty source documented per material state?
evaluation_dimensions.negative_control_discrimination: Are negative controls classified differently from productive transitions?
evaluation_dimensions.holdout_lifecycle: Did any holdout transition from OPENED back to SEALED?
evaluation_dimensions.protocol_compliance: Are protocol violations recorded with their own dispositions?

disposition_codes.CONSTRUCTED_AND_STRUCTURALLY_CLOSED: All required artifacts present; schema-valid; no known structural gaps.
disposition_codes.CONSTRUCTED_WITH_AMBIGUITIES: Required artifacts present; one or more interpretation ambiguities documented and preserved.
disposition_codes.TEST_PASS_BOUNDED: All automated structural tests pass within documented scope.
disposition_codes.TEST_FAIL: One or more automated structural tests fail.
disposition_codes.PROTOCOL_NONCONFORMANT: Protocol violation recorded; not erasable by semantic quality.
disposition_codes.RECOMPUTED_MATCH: Result independently recovered from frozen evidence; mechanically reproducible.
disposition_codes.RECOMPUTED_PARTIAL: Partial recovery; some elements match, others cannot be resolved.
disposition_codes.RECOMPUTATION_MISMATCH: Frozen evidence does not produce the claimed result.
disposition_codes.HOLDOUT_FAILURE: Holdout fixture produced unexpected result; recorded in evidence, instrument not modified.
disposition_codes.MEASUREMENT_AMBIGUITY: Scoring rule or rubric element does not deterministically resolve for this input.
disposition_codes.SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED: Defects found that require a separately versioned successor instrument; original preserved.

adjudication_rules: A protocol violation cannot be erased by a high-quality semantic result.
A failed holdout must be recorded and preserved; the instrument must not be modified to pass it retroactively.
If a test fails and requires repair, close the failed attempt, preserve it, and create a separately versioned successor.
Inability to recompute is not converted into a substantive failure of Lens Shift.
Measurement ambiguity is a finding about the instrument, not about Lens Shift.
